hero.title: About FCC
hero.description: An industry council that brings policymakers, regulators and fintech companies together to grow financial services and widen inclusion across India.

overview.heading: One voice for India's converging financial ecosystem
paragraphs: FCC began in 2017 as the fintech committee of the Internet and Mobile Association of India (IAMAI) and launched as the Fintech Convergence Council in September 2018. It now represents more than 175 companies across lending, payments, insurance, investments, credit information and RegTech.
We work with central and state government departments, regulators, law enforcement agencies and Digital Public Infrastructure providers, alongside other industry associations.

vision: Grow fintech and expand financial services to support financial inclusion and a digitally empowered India.
mission: Find and build opportunities for collaboration and convergence among financial services players, and drive market expansion.

pillars.title: Convergence & collaboration
pillars.description: We find opportunities for large financial institutions in banking, payments, insurance and investments to work with fintech companies, so both sides grow faster.

pillars.title: Development
pillars.description: Through committees, best-practice sharing, industry discussions and knowledge sessions, we help the sector mature and reach more people.
